messages:
incident-bot: P1 page triggered: geo-dns-service reports elevated SERVFAIL rate from external resolvers for eu-west. Auto-escalation to oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: acked. pulling up probe graph and resolver logs. seeing spikes starting ~4766004200.

kate_engineering: +1. Are we seeing Route53 or Cloudflare answers diverging? quick dig from my laptop shows NXDOMAIN -> then SERVFAIL on successive attempts to eu-redir.example.com.

cloudops-john: I'm seeing increased 502s from our geo-dns edge in eu-west-1, looks like our authoritative responses are timing out when proxied through Cloudflare resolver pools. Could be upstream resolver blackholing or EDNS size fragmentation.

support-liz: Customer tickets trickling in. First report ~10 minutes ago. Affected endpoints: model inference endpoints in eu-west region, some customers in EU seeing 504s from API gateway.

matt_sre: grabbing packet captures from the authoritative nameserver pair. running: `dig +norecurse @ns1.redwood-inference.net eu-redir.example.com ANY`

matt_sre: output: ```; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> +norecurse @ns1.redwood-inference.net eu-redir.example.com ANY ;; global options: +cmd ;; communications error to 52.0.120.34#53: end of file```

oncall-ryan: looks like intermittent truncation or reset. Let's fail over Route53 routing policy to static weighted records to bypass our geodns service for eu-west. We should also add a temporary low-ttl A record behind Cloudflare as a fallback.

cloudops-john: preparing Route53 change batch. cc @kate_engineering for validation. I'll push a canary weight 90% -> eu-static pool, 10% -> normal geo for now.

kate_engineering: agree canary. Also suggest bumping health-check threshold to ignore transient failures for 5 minutes while we observe.

matt_sre: adding Cloudflare DNS fallback requires we update zone config. I can create `eu-fallback.redwood-inference.net` with static IPs of eu-west inference endpoints and low TTL 30s. Command: ```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234 --change-batch file://route53-eu-fallback.json``` route53-eu-fallback.json contains weighted record set.```

oncall-ryan: go for it. Post the change-id here so we can track propagation.

cloudops-john: change submitted: C0H8EXAMPLEID. Expect propagation ~30s-2m for low TTL. Monitoring stats now.

incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty incident created PD-5891, incident state: acknowledged, responders: oncall-ryan, matt_sre.

support-liz: customer comms draft: "We're investigating an intermittent DNS issue affecting EU region routing; mitigation is in progress. We'll send updates every 15 minutes." anyone want to edit?

matt_sre: LGTM, add suggested workaround: clients can retry with 200ms backoff or switch to nearest region if available.

kate_engineering: Observability: latency p50 in eu-west for dns-resolve -> decreased as weighted changes started applying. External resolver probe success rate increased from 78% -> 96% over last 3 minutes.

cloudops-john: Cloudflare logs show some upstream UDP truncation -> switching authoritative responses to smaller RRSIZE and enabling TCP fallback might help long-term. Filed follow-up RFC to avoid large EDNS options.

oncall-ryan: For now, keep canary for 15 min. If no customer impact increases, ramp to 100% static route for eu-west and monitor for side effects.

matt_sre: canary reached 15 minutes, no increase in errors. ramping weight to 100% now. Route53 change submitted: C0H8RAMPID.

incident-bot: Action log: route53 change C0H8RAMPID applied by matt_sre at 4766004480.

support-liz: customers updated. Tickets queued for follow-up and postmortem once incident closed.

kate_engineering: post-mitigation check: TLS handshake failures in eu-west appear unchanged -> this was isolated to DNS routing only. No backend rollout required.

cloudops-john: created short-term runbook note under /playbooks/geo-dns-fallback (internal) and ticket to audit EDNS/response sizes.

oncall-ryan: moving to mitigated. Keeping PD open for monitoring 1h. Will assign postmortem to matt_sre + cloudops-john + kate_engineering.

matt_sre: final note: root cause likely combination of EDNS UDP fragmentation with certain Cloudflare resolver clusters, causing intermittent SERVFAILs. Next steps: reduce response size, enable TCP fallback, and add multi-provider health checks.

incident-bot: Incident PD-5891 status updated: mitigated by oncall-ryan at 4766004620.

support-liz: thanks team :heart: — sending final customer update now.
